# Execution Issues

## Warnings

- **Step 2 — retrofit acceptance criterion is a no-op against the committed tree.** The issue asks to retrofit "the 2 affected `final-summary.md` files" so their overstated Codex dollar figures drop. Direct inspection shows there is nothing to retrofit: the only committed runs containing `gpt-5.4-mini` tokens are 3 **design** runs (`458D5D01-6485-4491-A552-1CCAFB564675`, `F00F4F52-2EEE-42D6-90EE-9AB87D9C94CC`, and `E1170A72-B3C8-4C11-8539-D6DE547F5ACD`; the issue named 2, the 3rd landed via #5385). All three produce `plan-summary.md`, which carries no baked `💰` dollar line, and none committed a `final-summary.md`. No `/implement` run has committed any `gpt-5.4-mini` tokens. So no committed artifact holds an overstated dollar figure. The pricing fix corrects every cost surface going forward; previously-posted PR bodies are out of scope per the issue. Verified via `grep -rl gpt-5.4-mini larch-logs --include='larch-tokens-*.jsonl'` cross-checked against `final-summary.md` / `plan-summary.md` / `summary-final.md` for a baked `💰` line (zero matches).
- **Step 2 — `design_summary.py` updated although the issue's "Files involved" list omitted it.** The mini tokens live in design runs, so the per-model split must reach the design cost line; `_read_token_report` / `_build_cost_args` now emit `--codex-mini-*` flags. As a side effect this fixes a latent bug where design read `cache_read` (always absent in `BUCKETS_codex`) instead of `cached_input` for the Codex cached bucket, which had been zeroing Codex cached tokens in the design cost line.
